integration_path: Current D3D9 game-created shared GPU eye handles -> x64 host OpenSharedResource and per-frame descriptor/resource-identity gate
Exact two-eye GPU CopyResource into R23 host-owned staging -> OpenXR projection RTV per eye
Malformed, aliased or incompatible eyes fail closed and keep existing DX9Ex/SBS and gamepad path

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Two independent, same-shape D3D11 source descriptors are admitted in compiled host regression
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Zero generation, duplicate eye handles, missing eye, mismatched dimensions/format/mips/array/MSAA/non-SRV sources rejected before CopyResource or projection
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Live host GPU shared-handle importer and real R23 CopyResource/OpenXR projection staging both call the same exact stereo admissibility; unchanged DX9Ex/gamepad fallback

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Existing native game Draw produces a diagnostic visible inset, while host shared-eye DirectGPU is a separate production path. This change validates both host import and OpenXR staging, not a claim that native game Draw is already wired to the shared-eye producer. Real Quest3 frame and gamepad NEED_HMD_TEST.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Original D3D9 Draw/gamepad and SBS continue; native shared-eye output only with valid opt-in producer transport

feature_contract.goal: Protect actual native game stereo texture import through R23 OpenXR GPU copy and projection from aliased, mismatched and incompatible eye resources while preserving game fallback

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Both distinct valid game-created GPU eyes stage to independent OpenXR projection SRVs
Aliased, mismatched or unusable eyes are rejected without changing original game Draw/input and Classic SBS recovery
Compiled positive/negative native host direct eye regression plus required exact SHA GitHub Actions gates pass
Real menu, vehicle, race stereo parity and gamepad remain hardware-only

pipeline.C1_REVIEW: Host direct source import allowed aliased eye handles and cached pair descriptor mismatches; distinct native producer/host tests preexist but active host projection contract was weak
